title: Add LRU eviction to an existing cache
task:
`src/cache.js` contains a `Cache` class that grows forever. Add least-recently-used (LRU) eviction without breaking existing callers.

Requirements:

- The constructor accepts an optional options object: `new Cache({ maxSize, onEvict })`.
  - `maxSize` defaults to `Infinity`. It must be `Infinity` or an integer >= 1; otherwise throw a `RangeError`.
  - `onEvict(key, value)` is optional. Call it once for every entry removed because the cache was full. Do NOT call it for `delete()`, `clear()`, or when `set()` overwrites an existing key.
- `new Cache()` with no arguments must keep working exactly as before.
- When `set()` would make `size` exceed `maxSize`, evict the least recently used entry.
- `get(key)` of an existing key and `set(key, value)` (new or existing key) mark that key as most recently used. `has(key)` does NOT change recency.
- Add `delete(key)` (returns `true` if the key existed, else `false`) and `clear()`.
- Add `keys()` returning an array of keys ordered from least to most recently used.
- `set()` keeps returning `this` so calls can be chained. `size` stays a getter.

Run the tests with `npm test`.
